messages:
sofia: Hey @ben @ellis — I need ephemeral read access to prod logs (S3) to validate that PII was redacted for a GDPR deletion request. Need ~2 hours today. Will follow P-ACCESS-07 checklist. :lock:
ben: What's the exact S3 path and justification? We need ticket/incident number and timeframe for the audit entry.
sofia: Ticket INC-2026-4187. Path: s3://redwood-prod/logs/http/2026-03-16/ — specifically files matching user_id=U-9876. Just need 2 files to confirm emails are hashed. Time window: 14:00–16:00 PDT. Won't copy whole bucket.
ellis: For org controls I'll spin up an ephemeral IAM role with STS for 2h. What's your AWS username/ARN so I can grant it? We'll also enable CloudTrail session lookup.
sofia: IAM name: sofia.k (aws:sofia@redwood). Confirming read-only, will not upload or broadly export RAW logs.
sec-bot: Reminder: P-ACCESS-07 requires the requester to post justification, attach ticket ID, and use ephemeral role naming `ephemeral/<user>/<ticket>`. All activity will be audited. React with :eyes: to proceed.
ben: Approving for 2 hours under conditions: ephemeral role only, session recording enabled, no redacted data shared externally. I will add approval note to the audit entry.
ellis: Role created: `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ephemeral/sofia/INC-4187` (2h expiry). To assume:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ephemeral/sofia/INC-4187 --role-session-name inc4187-session
```
After assuming, run:
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-prod/logs/http/2026-03-16/user_U-9876.json ./ --profile temp-sofia
```
I'll tag CloudTrail with `access:INC-4187` and attach the approval note.
sofia: Got it, starting the session now. I'll grep locally for email patterns, verify hashing/redaction, then securely delete my local copy. Will paste results summary (no screenshots). :thumbsup:
nick: Quick policy note — if you see unredacted PII, do NOT post it in Slack. Escalate to privacy@redwood and tag me (nick) immediately.
sofia: Understood. Running the checks and will report back with redaction confirmation or escalate. Thanks everyone. :eyes:
